# Simple Podcast Manager v1.1.2
- Publishes a visible version bump so the updater can confirm the SemVer display path is working. - No app workflow changes are included in this verification release. - No action is required after updating.

# Simple Podcast Manager v0.1.1
- Removes `Download All` from podcast detail views to avoid accidental large downloads. - Adds a refresh button for the selected podcast so one feed can be checked without refreshing every show. - Shortens show toolbar hover labels to `Edit` and `Remove`. - Shows a real user-visible version bump in Sparkle update prompts instead of another hidden beta number. - Keeps multiple recent Sparkle release-note entries so users updating across skipped versions can review what changed. - No action is required after updating.

# Simple Podcast Manager v0.1.0-beta.33
- Removes `Download All` from podcast detail views to avoid accidental large downloads. - Adds a refresh button for the selected podcast so one feed can be checked without refreshing every show. - Shortens show toolbar hover labels to `Edit` and `Remove`. - Keeps multiple recent Sparkle release-note entries so users updating across skipped versions can review what changed. - No action is required after updating.

# Simple Podcast Manager v0.1.0-beta.32
- Removes stale subscription retention internals that were no longer used by the app. - Keeps older app data compatible: subscriptions saved with the old retention field still load normally. - Cleans up old compatibility names around device podcast folders and sync success state. - No action is required after updating.
